name: video-os-bench
description: A Hugging Face dataset benchmarking video-level object/scene understanding tasks, providing video clips and annotations for evaluating video object segmentation, tracking, and detection models. It measures models' ability to localize and segment objects consistently across frames and to handle occlusion and motion.
evaluation_method: mIoU / IoU / tracking accuracy (standard video-vision metrics)
reputation: A niche, community-contributed Hugging Face dataset with limited but growing use among practitioners evaluating video object-level tasks.
